Repository¶

Contacts repository¶

async src.repository.contacts.create_contact(db: AsyncSession, user: User, contact_data: ContactCreateSchema) → Contact[source]¶

Create and persist a new contact with its phone numbers.

Parameters:

  • db – Asynchronous database session.

  • user – User who owns the new contact.

  • contact_data – Validated data used to create the contact.

Returns:

Newly created contact.

async src.repository.contacts.delete_contact(db: AsyncSession, user: User, contact_id: int) → Contact | None[source]¶

Delete a contact owned by the specified user.

Parameters:

  • db – Asynchronous database session.

  • user – User who owns the contact.

  • contact_id – Identifier of the contact to delete.

Returns:

Deleted contact if found, otherwise None.

async src.repository.contacts.get_contact_by_id(db: AsyncSession, user: User, contact_id: int) → Contact | None[source]¶

Return a contact by its identifier.

The contact is selected only if it belongs to the specified user.

Parameters:

  • db – Asynchronous database session.

  • user – User who owns the contact.

  • contact_id – Identifier of the contact.

Returns:

Contact instance if found, otherwise None.

async src.repository.contacts.get_contacts(db: AsyncSession, user: User, skip: int = 0, limit: int = 100) → Sequence[Contact][source]¶

Return a paginated list of contacts owned by the specified user.

Phone relationships are loaded together with each contact.

Parameters:

  • db – Asynchronous database session.

  • user – User who owns the contacts.

  • skip – Number of contacts to skip.

  • limit – Maximum number of contacts to return.

Returns:

Sequence of contacts belonging to the user.

async src.repository.contacts.update_contact(db: AsyncSession, user: User, contact_data: ContactUpdateSchema, contact_id: int) → Contact | None[source]¶

Update an existing contact owned by the specified user.

Parameters:

  • db – Asynchronous database session.

  • user – User who owns the contact.

  • contact_data – Validated contact update data.

  • contact_id – Identifier of the contact to update.

Returns:

Updated contact if found, otherwise None.

Search repository¶

async src.repository.searchs.get_contacts_with_upcoming_birthdays(db: AsyncSession, user: User) → Sequence[Contact][source]¶

Return contacts with birthdays occurring within the next seven days.

The current day is included in the search interval.

Parameters:

  • db – Asynchronous database session.

  • user – User whose contacts are checked.

Returns:

Sequence of contacts with upcoming birthdays.

async src.repository.searchs.search_contacts(db: AsyncSession, user: User, query: str) → Sequence[Contact][source]¶

Search contacts by first name, last name, or email address.

The search is case-insensitive and limited to contacts owned by the specified user.

Parameters:

  • db – Asynchronous database session.

  • user – User whose contacts are searched.

  • query – Search string.

Returns:

Sequence of matching contacts.
